founded on

  • CURIE: gmeow:foundedOn
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/foundedOn
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/agreements

The agreement or contract that grounds this relator — in UFO terms, the set of commitments on which the relator is founded. Reusable across any relator (Membership, KinRelationship, etc.).

Structure

Property shape: object property; gufo:Relator -> gmeow:Agreement

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:foundedOn from gufo:Relator to gmeow:Agreement when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
